title: An issue or PR's own timeline comment claims a milestone number that doesn't exist
author: esu-elegba
description: Extracts every 'milestone #N' claim phrase (the shared seam_engine.milestone_claims grammar) from an issue or pull request's own ordinary timeline comment and checks whether the named milestone exists at all. issue-comment-claims-open-milestone's own docstring named this exact seam and left it open on purpose: a claimed milestone number that names no real milestone at all was excluded there as belonging to 'a future milestone-side dangling-reference recipe's own seam, not this one's.' This recipe is that seam, on the one surface that named it -- the issue-comment-sourced sibling of commit-claims-dangling-milestone, which closed the identical seam for a commit message. Not whether a real milestone's claim is TRUE (issue-comment-claims-open-milestone's own remit), but whether the number the claim names resolves to anything real. Genuinely distinct from issue-comment-dangling-reference: milestones and issues/PRs are separate GitHub number spaces, so a #N that is a real issue could still be a dangling milestone claim, and issue-comment-dangling-reference never opens ListMilestones at all.
confidence_notes: Flat 0.8, not age-gated -- mirrors commit-claims-dangling-milestone's own reasoning rather than issue-comment-claims-open-milestone's 24-hour edit-grace bar: an OPEN milestone could close at any moment, so a fresh claim about it might just be a race the comment hasn't caught up to yet, but a milestone number that does not exist right now will not spontaneously start existing later, so there is no grace period that means anything here -- this holds even though a comment (unlike a commit message) stays editable forever, because the editability of the surface has no bearing on whether the milestone NUMBER it names exists. A claimed milestone number that DOES resolve to a real milestone is excluded at confidence 0.0 regardless of whether that milestone is open or closed -- whether the claim is true is issue-comment-claims-open-milestone's own seam, not this one's. A comment with no 'milestone #N' claim phrase at all, or no body at all, produces no surfaced candidate -- there is no claim to have broken. Fixture-only (source: "fixture") per SCOPES.md's own WIP note on issue-comment-dangling-reference: no read-only 'list issue/PR comments' tool is exposed anywhere on the-hand gateway today -- the detection logic is real, the live read waits on the Hand's gateway, and only the fixture loader swaps for a real call the day one appears.
